narrationScript: Welcome to 'Client-Side Scripting with JavaScript'. While HTML gives our web pages structure and CSS adds style, JavaScript is the powerful programming language that truly brings them to life. It's the brain behind dynamic and interactive web experiences. In this lesson, we'll explore how JavaScript transforms static content into engaging applications. Our key objectives are to understand JavaScript's role in adding interactivity. We'll learn how to properly include JavaScript within an HTML document, exploring different methods and best practices. You'll gain skills in manipulating the Document Object Model, or DOM, to dynamically alter HTML content and styles. We'll also delve into implementing event listeners, allowing your web pages to respond to user interactions like clicks and key presses. Finally, you'll learn to write basic JavaScript functions and variables to build simple, interactive elements.
